summary: Follow-up to iteration 15, tested in real (non-demo) mode against the public URL. All 6 fixes were verified in both the backend and the UI. Backend: 3 live pytest tests in /tmp/iter16/test_iter16.py, 3/3 passed. (1) A reminder with no mailbox returns 400 'Sollecito non spedito: il titolare deve prima configurare la casella email...' and invoice.reminders stays at 0. (2) An amministrazione collaborator ran request-payment, then the owner ran a manual authorize ({ok, manual:true}). The collaborator got the notification 'Pagamento autorizzato' with the text '...autorizzato, va eseguito dall'home banking.' (3) /assistant/status returns reads_receipts=true and provider=claude. The Claude answer to 'Riepilogo saldi e scadenze del mese' (5.3s) has no '**', no tables and no '#' headings, and the figures are correct (saldo 10.000, da pagare 988, da incassare 1.220). Frontend (Playwright, owner and collaborator logged in with TOTP): on Crediti, sending a reminder shows the error inside the modal. After closing it the button is still 'Sollecita' and the Solleciti column still says 'Nessuno'. In Impostazioni the orange 'Le email non partono ancora' notice was visible before saving and disappeared right after saving the Aruba preset with fake credentials, without a reload. 'Invia prova' shows the error box 'Invio non riuscito...', and email-last-test changes to '· non riuscita' without a reload. The first SMTP attempt took about 8s and later ones about 1s; my first script read the page too early, which was a test timing issue and not a bug. The collaborator's bell showed '1 da leggere' and /notifiche listed 'Pagamento autorizzato'. The assistant UI answer was plain text with dash lists only.
